stem: Collagen is a fibrous protein that is found in many tissues in animals.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the structure of a collagen molecule **and** the structure of a collagen fibre.

parts.label: (b)

parts.text: Give the precise name of the monosaccharide labelled **D** in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:

Write your answer on Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Osteogenesis imperfecta is a disease that results from a deficiency in collagen.

Suggest how a **named** tissue or structure is affected in a person who has this disease.
